filled.angle_exceeds_critical_angle_no_light_: Angle ej eḷḷā jān critical angle. Ejjeḷọk light ej deḷọñ — aolep rej jepḷaak. Eñin pedped in fiber optics, meram in diamond, prism periscopes.
filled.approaching_tir_boundary_refracted_ray: Epaak ñan TIR boundary. Refracted ray ej etal epaak surface; transmitted intensity ej wanlaḷḷọk.
filled.light_entering_denser_medium_n_n_refra: Light ej deḷọñ ilo denser medium (n₁ < n₂). Refracted ray ej ip ÑAN normal — light eruṃwij ilo dense medium.
filled.light_entering_less_dense_medium_refra: Light ej deḷọñ ilo less-dense medium. Refracted ray ej ip ETTOḶỌK jān normal — light eṃōkaj ilo light medium.
filled.steep_angle_from_normal_much_energy_re: Angle epen jān normal. Elōñ energy ej jepḷaak (Fresnel ej wanlōñḷọk), edik ej deḷọñ.
filled.set_n_n_incidence_angle_and_wavelength: Kōṃṃan n₁, n₂, incidence angle, im wavelength. Aikuji ia eo system ej oktak jān refraction ñan TIR. Ejjeḷọk score, ejjeḷọk reveal.
filled.your_hypothesis_where_exactly_does_tir: Hypothesis eo aṃ (ia eo TIR ej jino ie, im etke diamond ej TIR eḷapḷọk jān glass?)
filled.e_g_diamond_has_critical_angle_24_vs_g: waanjoñak, diamond ewōr critical angle ~24° ak glass ~42°, kōn menin jabdewōt angle epen ej TIR...
filled.i_m_stuck_show_open_questions: 🤔 Ij jaḷ — kwaḷọk questions ko rōpeḷḷọk
filled.why_is_there_no_critical_angle_when_go: Etke ejjeḷọk critical angle ñe kwōj etal jān less-dense ñan more-dense?
filled.set_water_air_n_1_33_n_1_00_what_s_the: Kōṃṃan water→air (n₁=1.33 n₂=1.00). Ta critical angle eo? Etke ek rej lo laḷ eo eṃōj kobaik ilo juon cone ilōñ?
filled.in_a_rainbow_why_does_red_bend_less_th: Ilo juon rainbow, etke būrōrō ej ip edikḷọk jān buḷuḷ? Kobaik ñan wavelength slider.
filled.how_does_a_prism_separate_white_light_: Ewi wāween an prism kōjepel white light ñe aolep wavelengths rej loore Snell's law eo wōt?
filled.i_can_explain_why_this_n_n_combination: Imaroñ kōmḷeḷeik etke n₁/n₂/θ combination in ej kōṃṃan refraction state in.
filled.inquiry_widget_no_score_no_reveal_no_a: Inquiry widget — ejjeḷọk score, ejjeḷọk reveal, ejjeḷọk answer dump. Dispersion model ej illustrative (Cauchy-like first-order); dispersion curves ṃool rej material-specific (Sellmeier coefficients).
